# Luc de Clapiers, Marquis de Vauvenargues

*1715 – 1747 · French*

An officer who died at thirty-one, he defends against [La Rochefoucauld](../philosophers/la-rochefoucauld.md) and [Pascal](../philosophers/pascal.md) the greatness of the passions and the possible goodness of man: "Great thoughts come from the heart."
